# Align Technology to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 28, 2026


TEMPE, Ariz.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 1, 2026-- Align Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALGN) a leading global medical device company that designs, manufactures, and sells the Invisalign® System of clear aligners, iTero™ intraoral scanners, and exocad™ CAD/CAM software for digital orthodontics and restorative dentistry, today announced that it will report third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after the close of market. Financial results will be released at 4:00 p.m. ET (1:00 p.m. PT) and will be available on the Investor Relations section of Align’s website at[http://investor.aligntech.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aligntech.com&esheet=54609081&newsitemid=20261001477408&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aligntech.com&index=1&md5=dda9ec4c3ce975b8a8fcc1326e4ebfc5) .


Following the press release, Align will host a conference call to discuss its financial results. The conference call will begin at 4:30 p.m. ET (1:30 p.m. PT) and will also be available as an audio webcast live via the Internet. Participants may pre-register for the call by clicking[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2Fqyykh4hq%2F&esheet=54609081&newsitemid=20261001477408&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=4d6fc79663482e23cd2bdb0e3c2fde39) . The call will also be accessible via webcast on the Investor Relations section of Align’s website or by visiting[http://investor.aligntech.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aligntech.com&esheet=54609081&newsitemid=20261001477408&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.aligntech.com&index=3&md5=e3486b185daa8ecf24112491f6378413) . An archived audio webcast will be available two hours after the call's conclusion and will remain available for approximately one month.


**About Align Technology, Inc.**


Align Technology designs and manufactures the Invisalign® System, the most advanced clear aligner system in the world, iTero™ intraoral scanners and services, and exocad™ CAD/CAM software. These technology building blocks enable enhanced digital orthodontic and restorative workflows to improve patient outcomes and practice efficiencies for over 302.0 thousand doctor customers and are key to accessing Align’s 600 million consumer market opportunity worldwide. Over the past 29 years, Align has helped doctors treat approximately 23.5 million patients with the Invisalign System and is driving the evolution in digital dentistry through the Align™ Digital Platform, our integrated suite of unique, proprietary technologies and services delivered as a seamless, end-to-end solution for patients and consumers, orthodontists and GP dentists, and lab/partners. Visit[www.aligntech.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aligntech.com&esheet=54609081&newsitemid=20261001477408&lan=en-US&anchor=www.aligntech.com&index=4&md5=372269fd4becaf9bdf427feb1f467326) for more information.


For additional information about the Invisalign system or to find an Invisalign doctor in your area, please visit[www.invisalign.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.invisalign.com&esheet=54609081&newsitemid=20261001477408&lan=en-US&anchor=www.invisalign.com&index=5&md5=69fa122bba00cdd0e4e2a4d8f7fa31c8) .
